title: Chasing Shadows
lead_in: This one needs sun. In flat cloud, choose a different mission.
prompt: Find a shadow that is more interesting than the thing making it. Photograph the shadow, not the object.
notice: A shadow bending as it crosses something
questions: Where is the light coming from?
Is the shadow sharp or soft, and why?
What happens if you leave the object out of the frame completely?
Would it be stronger from higher up or lower down?
How does the surface change the shape of the shadow?
technical_reminder: Bright sun and deep shadow are a lot for the camera to hold at once. If the shadow goes solid black, that can be the point — but check whether you wanted the detail.

variation.text: Make the shadow look like something it is not — an animal, a face, a word.

review_prompt: Which photograph makes the shadow the subject rather than the leftover?
partner_activity: Partners can guess what made each shadow.
